name: kinderlou
summary: Lowndes County lookout that served Kinderlou Forest from 1939 to 1993; its tower now stands at Grand Bay WMA, where a DNR notice dated 10/8/26 closes the boardwalk.
status_note: The 54-foot tower served Kinderlou Forest from 1939 to 1993; the sources suggest it now stands at the end of the Grand Bay boardwalk. No source describes the Kinderlou Forest site today.

access.note: Applies to the tower at Grand Bay. The DNR notice posted 10/8/26 says the boardwalk is closed until further notice. The Kinderlou Forest site's access is not described.

visit.trail_note: Reached by a half-mile boardwalk from the Grand Bay Wetland Education Center. The boardwalk is closed until further notice per the DNR notice posted 10/8/26.

events.note: Start of fire-lookout service in Kinderlou Forest, per the 2012 photo essay. Construction date not given.
End of fire-lookout service in Kinderlou Forest, per the 2012 photo essay.
DNR notice posted 10/8/26: the Grand Bay boardwalk, which ends at the tower, is closed until further notice.
